articles.title: RFK Jr. adviser Calley Means resigns amid growing MAHA discontent over lack of progress - PBS
articles.description: Calley Means, a top adviser to Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and a chief advocate for the Make America Healthy Again movement, resigned from his position with the Trump administration Thursday.
